resources.string: Use Turnip + Zink instead of Freedreno (kgsl)
Render on the CPU (llvmpipe) instead of the GPU (virgl): slow, for comparison
Update BAR at every start, like BAR\'s PC launcher (engine, game, lobby; back to the last working version if an update fails to start). Off: Install / Update updates
Open the lobby when the app starts (long-press the app icon → Launcher for this screen)
Controller support v0.8.5 in singleplayer (skirmish and the lobby\'s own games; online games play BAR\'s released game)
Sharper upscaling (Qualcomm SGSR): the game is drawn smaller than the screen and enlarged; SGSR keeps edges sharp where plain enlarging blurs them
Compare upscaling (diagnostic): SGSR on and off every 3 seconds, with a label; the two game freezes of 2026-10-27 were with it on
Lobby bridge: the app stands in for BAR\'s PC launcher, for the Replays tab, web links and skill ratings; the lobby\'s downloads go through the app (off: the Replays tab cannot list replays)
BAR touch controls (drag pans, pinch zooms, twist rotates, two fingers up/down tilt, tap then drag selects, long press orders); off = Termux:X11 touch modes
